headline: Corporate Communications Manager
summary: Corporate communications manager with ten years in energy and cooperatives across Bicol. I lead internal and external communications, write executive speeches and annual reports, and advise management on public relations during outages and disasters. I manage a team of four writers and designers.

experience.title: Corporate Communications Manager
experience.paragraph: Head of a four-person team handling media, community and employee communications for a power generation company.
bullets: Write the president's speeches, board letters and the annual sustainability report.
Advise management on statements during eruption alerts and typhoon outages, and speak to local media.
Set the company's content plan across newsletter, website and social media.
Wrote the house style guide and edit all published materials against it.

experience.title: Communications Officer
experience.paragraph: Covered member communications for eight electric cooperatives in the region.
bullets: Produced the monthly member newsletter and rewrote technical advisories in plain language.
Wrote job descriptions and recruitment copy with HR during a restructuring.
